name: Companion App
description: LAN API for the Android companion app and the plain phone-browser remote (remote/, no app install needed) — remote control, quick-tap channel grid, channel favorite editor, trivia trigger, edit every box-wide setting, and browse/download files from your channel folders, all from your phone. One pairing covers all of it. Pairing-code + session auth, same as the other LAN services — once paired, a device stays paired across restarts, no need to re-enter the code every time. Runs same-process (not isolated) because file browsing needs real filesystem access to wherever your channel folders actually live, which the isolated-plugin sandbox can't grant. Works standalone; if the Party Channel plugin is also installed, channel reactions also work.

ipc.why: receives the current channel/name from the renderer, to answer the phone remote's GET /state

net.why: the Android companion app and the phone-browser remote connect to this from the LAN
